settings.tab_content: Harvested under global organic textile standards. Non-toxic harvesting guarantees fibers are free from chemical fertilizers and pesticides.
Certified free of over 350 harmful substances and heavy metals. Safely protects baby's highly permeable skin barrier from allergies.
Constructed with special active flat-lock sewing patterns. Zero raised threads ensures minimal friction against sensitive skin creases.
Dyed using strictly non-azo herbal extracts (derived from pomegranates, indigo leaves, turmeric). 100% heavy metal-free process.
